rows.title: Function identity
rows.conditions: Canonical function unchanged; separate rich identity.

rows.title: Input contract
rows.conditions: Five inputs accounted for; exact signature recorded.

rows.title: Return contract
rows.conditions: Canonical boolean unchanged; rich schema versioned.

rows.title: Ordering
rows.conditions: Default/public deterministic ordering; changes require approval.

rows.title: Limit
rows.conditions: No implicit pagination; limit changes require approval.

rows.title: NULL semantics
rows.approved_contract: Required NULL/blank validation error; optional NULL filter not applied; NULL database field does not match; NULL similarity is not duplicate evidence.
rows.conditions: Deterministic NULL behavior; no silent success for invalid input.

rows.title: Error semantics
rows.approved_contract: Validation, success-empty, database error, authorization error, timeout/error semantics as supplied.
rows.conditions: Database failure is not no duplicate.

rows.title: Data visibility scope
rows.conditions: Caller-authorized records only; no invented tenancy.

rows.title: Index strategy
rows.conditions: No speculative index; query-plan evidence required.

rows.title: Migration strategy
rows.conditions: Non-Production only after consistency validation; Production unauthorized.

rows.title: Rollback
rows.conditions: Rollback defined and testable; canonical preserved.
